package techversion

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteTechVersion deletes tech version by id.
type DeleteTechVersion struct {
	TechVersions repository.TechVersionRepository
}

// Handle deletes tech version.
func (uc DeleteTechVersion) Handle(ctx context.Context, id int) error {
	if id <= 0 {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.TechVersions.Delete(ctx, id)
}
